label: Diagram D7
caption: Diagram D7 Free area of smoke ventilators
description: Diagram D7, "Free area of smoke ventilators", has two parts. Part a. is an elevation of an open hinged window panel, pivoted at its base at the left-hand grey reveal block, the opening being set between the two grey reveal blocks. From the hinge a dashed line projects diagonally upwards to the right and is continued as a short dashed line below the horizontal line on the other side of the hinge. A solid horizontal line (the bottom of the opening) runs from the hinge to the right-hand block, and a right-angle symbol marked 90° is shown at the hinge between this horizontal line and the dashed line. A green double-headed arrow, drawn at right angles to the dashed line, runs from the dashed line to the right-hand edge of the opening and is labelled "Free area measured at right angles to air flow". Part b. is an elevation of a closed louvred vent showing five inclined slats set between two grey frame blocks; dashed lines extend the plane of each slat. Above each slat sits a small green double-headed arrow, labelled in turn a₁, a₂, a₃, a₄ and a₅. The accompanying text reads "Free area for louvred vent = a₁ +a₂ +a₃ +a₄ +a₅".
